extensions.nightMode: afnon-mihrab/tokens.night.json: near-black lapis (#0B0A08 ground), gold at about half brightness (#84703F), focus a dim amber fill with light text.

components.name: Header pill
components.description: Radio, Wi-Fi, Live: a round lapis pill with an icon and a word; gold fill when focused.
components.html: <button class="ds-pill"><svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"/><path d="M16.2 7.8a6 6 0 0 1 0 8.4M7.8 16.2a6 6 0 0 1 0-8.4"/></svg>الإذاعة</button>
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; height: 72px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 999px; background: #12264A; color: #EFE7D6; border: 2px solid rgba(239,231,214,0.25); font: 400 24px Alexandria, sans-serif; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), background 120ms; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { background: #D8B46A; color: #0C1B33; outline: 4px solid #EFE7D6; outline-offset: 6px; transform: scale(1.06); }

components.name: Fast chip (unread)
components.description: The coming fast, on the Gregorian date's line: gold outline and words until opened.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip ds-chip-unread">غدًا الأربعاء: آخر الأيام البيض</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 48px; padding: 0 26px 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: #12264A; color: #EFE7D6; border: 2px solid rgba(239,231,214,0.25); font: 400 24px Alexandria, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-unread { border: 3px solid #D8B46A; color: #D8B46A; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { background: #D8B46A; color: #0C1B33; outline: 4px solid #EFE7D6; outline-offset: 6px; transform: scale(1.06); }

components.name: Favourite tile
components.description: An app on Home: lapis surface, 18px corners; gold fill and plaster ring when focused.
components.css: .ds-tile { width: 248px; height: 150px; border-radius: 18px; background: #12264A; color: #EFE7D6; border: none; font: 400 30px Alexandria, sans-serif; text-align: start; padding: 22px 24px; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { background: #D8B46A; color: #0C1B33; outline: 4px solid #EFE7D6; outline-offset: 6px; transform: scale(1.06); }

components.name: Prayer cell (current)
components.description: The prayer whose time it is: a plaster cell with night lapis words. Never focusable.
components.css: .ds-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 167px; height: 146px; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 14px; background: #EFE7D6; color: #0C1B33; font: 400 26px Alexandria, sans-serif; } .ds-cell small { font-size: 20px; } .ds-cell span { font-size: 34px; }

narrative.overview: Afnon is a prayer niche lit in the evening. The screen is night lapis; one lamp of gold marks what matters now: the next prayer, its countdown, the focused choice. Everything else sits back in mist and plaster until the remote reaches it. The mood is calm, reverent and quiet: watched from a sofa by a family through the day, so nothing shouts, blinks or competes; only the prayer time rises. It must never become kitsch religious decor.
keyCharacteristics: Night lapis ground, one gold accent, plaster for what is current.
An arch that always shows the next prayer, never covered or focusable at its crown.
Arabic first (RTL), English second; Western or Eastern digits independent of language.
Flat: depth from lapis steps and rings, never shadows or blur.
Transform and opacity only, and the TV may have animations off.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Gold marks what matters now: the next prayer, the focused control, the sacred text. If a second thing on the screen glows gold without being one of these, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Plaster Is Now Rule
rules.body: A plaster fill means current: the prayer whose time it is, the chosen segment, the reminder card. It is never used for decoration.

rules.name: The Twenty Pixel Floor
rules.body: Nothing on screen is smaller than 20px at 1080p (about 13px on a 720p panel); it is read from a sofa.

rules.name: The Unspaced Arabic Rule
rules.body: Arabic is never letter-spaced; English caps labels alone take 0.2em.

rules.name: The Exact Text Rule
rules.body: Qur'an and hadith are quoted word for word (checked in the Shamela library), with their source; a paraphrase is never set in the sacred style.

rules.name: The Solid Ring Rule
rules.body: The only thing that lifts an element is focus: a gold fill, a plaster ring and a small scale. Nothing is lifted by a shadow.

dos: Do take every colour, size and timing from tokens.json (night mode from tokens.night.json).
Do keep text at 20px or more at 1080p, and check both 1080p and the 720p TCL.
Do check every screen in Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR), with Western and Eastern digits.
Do quote Qur'an and hadith exactly, in Amiri 400 gold, with the source under it.
Do spell out the D-pad focus for each screen, with Left and Right swapped in Arabic.
donts: Don't add kitsch religious decor: glitter, clip-art domes or minarets, green gradients, calligraphy as wallpaper.
Don't use shadows, blur or glass; depth is lapis steps and the focus ring.
Don't fill anything gold at rest: a gold fill means focus.
Don't animate anything but transform and opacity, or rely on an animation the TV may have turned off.
Don't cover the arch's crown, or make it focusable.
